title: Input-length configuration update
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be finite Boolean strings, let $d$ be a configuration of the one-work-tape input-length machine on input $x$, let $r$ be a natural number, let $s$ be one of its phases, let $ip$ be a valid input-head position for $x$, and let $z$ be an integer. The updated configuration has state $s$, input-head position $ip$, and output equal to that of $d$; its work-head position is shifted by $z$, and on the $r$ cells beginning at the old work-head position its tape contains $w$, while all other cells retain their contents from $d$.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $d$ of the one-work-tape machine on $x$
